I'm so sorry to hear that there's been a technical issue. I was really hoping to talk to someone today about how I've been feeling. To be honest, it's been really tough lately. I feel like I'm just going through the motions of taking care of my baby, but I'm exhausted all the time. I worry constantly about my baby's health and safety, and it's hard for me to shake off those thoughts. Some days, I just feel so sad and discouraged, like I'm not doing anything right. I've even caught myself crying a few times a week, usually when I'm feeling really stressed. I just wish I could enjoy the things I used to like before having my baby, but lately, nothing seems to bring me much joy. Can we...can we try to talk anyway, even if it's not through that thing? I really need someone to talk to.
I have been able to laugh and see the funny side of things

To be honest, I haven't been able to laugh as much as I used to. Things that used to make me smile just don't seem as funny anymore. I feel like I've lost a part of myself, and it's hard for me to find the joy in things. Even when my baby does something adorable, I feel like I'm just going through the motions of smiling and cooing, but inside, I'm still feeling really down. It's like I'm watching myself from outside my body, and I wish I could feel more connected to my emotions and my baby. Sometimes, I feel like I'm just pretending to be a good mom, but really, I'm just trying to survive each day. It's hard for me to explain, but it feels like a big part of me is missing, and I don't know how to get it back.
I have looked forward with enjoyment to things

I haven't really been looking forward to things like I used to. Most days, I just feel like I'm trying to get through the basics of taking care of my baby and the house, and I don't really have the energy or interest to think about things I used to enjoy. Even things that I loved before, like reading or taking a walk, just don't seem as appealing to me right now. I feel like I'm just going through the motions of being a new mom, and I'm not really experiencing any joy or excitement. Sometimes, my husband will suggest we do something together, like go for a walk or watch a movie, and I'll think, "Oh, that sounds nice," but then when it's time to do it, I just feel too tired or overwhelmed, and I end up just wanting to be alone. It's like I've lost my sense of purpose and enjoyment, and I don't know how to get it back. It's really scary for me, because I feel like I'm supposed to be happy and excited about being a new mom, but instead, I just feel sad and empty.
I have blamed myself unnecessarily when things went wrong

Yes... that's something I've been doing a lot of lately. I feel like I'm always blaming myself for something. If my baby is crying, I think it's because I'm not doing something right. If I'm not producing enough milk, I feel like it's because I'm not eating the right foods or drinking enough water. If my baby gets a rash, I worry that it's because I didn't change their diaper quickly enough. It's like I'm always looking for ways to criticize myself and feel guilty about something. And it's not just the little things - I've even caught myself thinking that I'm not a good enough mother, that I'm not doing enough to provide for my baby's needs. It's like I have this constant voice in my head that's telling me I'm not good enough, and it's really hard to shake off. Sometimes, I feel like I'm just waiting for something to go wrong so I can beat myself up over it. It's exhausting, and it's making me feel really down on myself.
I have been anxious or worried for no good reason

That's been happening to me a lot lately. I'll be sitting there, feeding my baby or changing their diaper, and suddenly I'll start worrying about something that might happen. Like, what if my baby stops breathing? What if I accidentally leave them in the bathtub and they drown? What if I'm not producing enough milk and they're not getting enough to eat? It's like my mind just starts racing with all these worst-case scenarios, and I feel like I'm on edge all the time. Even when everything is fine, and my baby is happy and healthy, I still can't shake off the feeling of anxiety. It's like I'm always waiting for the other shoe to drop, and it's really hard to calm myself down. Sometimes, I'll be lying in bed at night, and I'll start thinking about all the things that could go wrong, and I'll feel my heart racing and my mind spinning. It's hard to fall asleep, and even when I do, I often wake up feeling anxious and on edge. It's like I'm constantly walking around with this sense of fear and worry, and it's really taking a toll on me.
I have felt scared or panicky for no very good reason

Yes... that's been happening to me too. I'll be doing something completely normal, like feeding my baby or playing with them, and suddenly I'll feel this wave of panic wash over me. My heart will start racing, and I'll feel like I'm going to hyperventilate. It's like my body is reacting to some kind of threat, but there's no actual danger there. It's really scary, because I don't know what's causing it, and I don't know how to make it stop. Sometimes, I'll be holding my baby, and I'll feel like I'm going to drop them or hurt them in some way, and I'll get this overwhelming sense of fear and panic. It's like my mind is playing tricks on me, and it's really hard to calm myself down. I've even had times where I've felt like I'm going to pass out or lose control, and it's really terrifying. It's hard to explain, but it feels like my body is betraying me, and I don't know how to trust myself anymore. It's really affecting my ability to care for my baby, because I'm always worried that I'm going to do something wrong or that something bad is going to happen.
Things have been getting on top of me

Yes... that's exactly how I feel. Like, everything is just piling up on me, and I don't know how to keep up. Taking care of my baby is a 24/7 job, and it's exhausting. I feel like I'm constantly trying to keep my head above water, but it's hard to stay afloat. Even simple tasks, like laundry or cooking dinner, feel overwhelming to me right now. And it's not just the physical tasks - it's the emotional ones too. I feel like I'm constantly worrying about my baby's health and well-being, and it's taking a toll on me. Some days, I just feel like I'm barely holding it together. I'll be sitting there, feeding my baby or changing their diaper, and I'll just start crying because I feel so overwhelmed. It's like I'm just trying to survive each day, rather than actually living it. And it's hard, because I feel like I'm supposed to be this capable, competent mom, but really, I'm just feeling really lost and unsure of myself. It's like everything is just getting on top of me, and I don't know how to get out from under it all.
I have been so unhappy that I have had difficulty sleeping

Sleep... it's been a struggle for me lately. I've been having a hard time falling asleep, and even when I do, I wake up multiple times throughout the night. And it's not just because of the baby's feedings and changings - it's because my mind is racing and I'm feeling really overwhelmed. I'll lie in bed and just think about all the things that are worrying me, like my baby's health, or my ability to be a good mom, or just feeling like I'm not doing enough. And it's hard to turn my brain off, you know? It's like my mind is constantly going, going, going, and I just can't seem to relax. Even when I'm exhausted, I'll still be lying there, wide awake, feeling anxious and unhappy. And then when I do finally fall asleep, I'll have these vivid dreams or nightmares that will wake me up again. It's like my body is just not getting the rest it needs, and it's affecting my mood and my ability to cope with everything. Some nights, I'll just be sitting in the dark, feeding my baby, and I'll just start crying because I'm so tired and so unhappy. It's like I'm just running on empty, and I don't know how to refill my tank.
I have felt sad or miserable

Yes... that's been my reality for a while now. I feel like I'm just going through the motions of being a new mom, but inside, I'm feeling really sad and miserable. It's like I'm wearing this mask of happiness and competence, but underneath, I'm just struggling to keep my head above water. I feel like I'm not doing enough, like I'm not good enough, like I'm just pretending to be a mom. And it's hard, because everyone around me seems to be expecting me to be happy and fulfilled, like this is the best time of my life. But the truth is, it's not. It's hard, and it's exhausting, and it's emotionally draining. I feel like I'm just trying to survive each day, rather than actually enjoying it. And the sadness... it's just this constant feeling of emptiness and unhappiness. It's like I'm just walking around in a fog, and I don't know how to find my way out. Sometimes, I'll be holding my baby, and I'll just start crying because I feel so overwhelmed and sad. It's like my heart is just heavy with this grief and sadness, and I don't know how to lift it. I just feel so lost and alone, like I'm the only one who's feeling this way.
I have been so unhappy that I have been crying

Yes... the crying. It's like my body's way of releasing all the emotions that I've been trying to keep inside. I cry when I'm feeling overwhelmed, when I'm feeling sad, when I'm feeling anxious... it's like my emotions just overflow and I start crying. It's not just a few tears, either - it's like full-on sobbing, where I'm gasping for air and my body is shaking. It's embarrassing, because sometimes it happens in front of my husband or my family, and they don't know how to react. They'll try to comfort me, but it's hard for them to understand what I'm going through. And it's not just when something specific is wrong, either - it's just this general feeling of unhappiness and sadness that I've been carrying around. I'll be feeding my baby, or changing their diaper, or just sitting there holding them, and suddenly I'll just start crying. It's like my emotions are just right there, on the surface, and it doesn't take much to set me off. I've even caught myself crying when I'm alone, just because I feel so overwhelmed and sad. It's like my body is just trying to release all the stress and anxiety that I've been carrying around, and crying is the only way it knows how. It's hard, because I feel like I'm losing control, like I'm not the strong, capable person I used to be. But at the same time, it's almost a relief, because it's like my body is finally acknowledging all the emotions that I've been trying to keep inside.
The thought of harming myself has occurred to me
